final:
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    var count = 0
    for name in names
      let content = fs.read(name) else ""
      if content != ""
        count += 1
    return count
